title: Hiller Aviation Museum
scope: The standing hangar-like museum building at 601 Skyway Road with its entrance façade, stepped gallery and atrium wings, and rooftop Long-EZ exhibit on a static mount.
limitations: Height, roof drains and window positions on the less photographed elevations are estimated. The painted façade artwork is represented by its broad cladding colors. The model scope is the museum building and static rooftop display.
